meta.title: Daily Chess — one chess puzzle a day
meta.description: A new chess puzzle every day, themed training, Rush mode and classic games. Free, on phone and desktop.

daily.title: Daily challenge
daily.weekCurve: Difficulty rises through the week: Monday is easy, Sunday is for masters.
daily.normalCountsStreak: Normal counts toward your streak and gets harder through the week.

mateIn1.name: Mate in 1
mateIn1.desc: One move and it's over. Look for checks the king can't escape.

mateIn2.name: Mate in 2
mateIn2.desc: Two moves to mate. The first is usually a check or a sacrifice that strips the king's defense.

mateIn3.name: Mate in 3
mateIn3.desc: Three forcing moves to mate. Calculate every reply your opponent has.

fork.name: Fork
fork.desc: One piece attacks two or more pieces at once. The knight is the king of forks.

pin.name: Pin
pin.desc: A piece can't move because it would expose something more valuable behind it — sometimes the king.

skewer.name: Skewer
skewer.desc: The reverse of a pin: attack the valuable piece in front, it steps away, and you take the one behind.

discoveredAttack.name: Discovered attack
discoveredAttack.desc: One piece moves out of the way and unveils another's attack. Two threats at once.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.desc: Give up material on purpose to win something bigger: mate, more material, or a decisive attack.

deflection.name: Deflection
deflection.desc: Force a defender away from its post, and whatever it guarded falls.

endgame.name: Endgames
endgame.desc: Few pieces left. An active king, passed pawns and precision make all the difference.

advantage.name: Gain advantage
advantage.desc: A sequence of moves that leaves you clearly better. Think a few moves ahead.

backRankMate.name: Back-rank mate
backRankMate.desc: The king is trapped behind its own pawns. A rook or queen on the last rank finishes it.

smotheredMate.name: Smothered mate
smotheredMate.desc: The king is boxed in by its own pieces and mated by a knight, often after a queen sacrifice.

hangingPiece.name: Hanging piece
hangingPiece.desc: An undefended piece is waiting to be taken. Find it and win material for free.

promotion.name: Promotion
promotion.desc: Push the pawn to the last rank. Sometimes the best promotion is not a queen.

attraction.name: Attraction
attraction.desc: A sacrifice lures a piece, often the king, onto a bad square where it gets hit hard.

interference.name: Interference
interference.desc: Put a piece between two enemy pieces that defend each other and cut the link.

quietMove.name: Quiet move
quietMove.desc: No check, no capture, but the move sets up a threat that can't be stopped.

zugzwang.name: Zugzwang
zugzwang.desc: Your opponent has to move, and every move makes things worse for them.

train.title: Train by theme
train.subtitle: Pick a tactical pattern and practice until it becomes instinct. Puzzles adapt to your level.
train.error: We couldn't load the puzzles. Check your connection and try again.

rush.title: Rush
rush.subtitle: Three minutes, three lives. Puzzles get harder with every solve.
rush.finalScore: {n, plural, =0 {No puzzles solved this time.} one {# puzzle solved.} other {# puzzles solved.}}
rush.rule1: 3 minutes on the clock. Each solve is a point.
rush.rule2: 3 lives. One wrong move costs a life.
rush.rule3: Starts easy and heats up with every puzzle.

classics.title: Classics
classics.subtitle: Relive the most famous moments in chess history — and find the moves the masters found.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Every past daily challenge. Missed a day? Play it now (it won't count toward your streak).

profile.title: Your profile
profile.local: Your progress is saved in this browser.
profile.empty: Solve today's challenge to start your history.
profile.resetConfirm: Are you sure? This erases all your progress in this browser.

onboarding.s1Body: Every day at midnight a new puzzle arrives — the same for everyone. Solve it and compare with friends.
onboarding.s2Body: Tap a piece, then its destination, or drag it. Wrong? Try again. Hints are always there.
onboarding.s3Body: Come back tomorrow to keep your streak alive. The week starts easy and ends hard.

footer.lichess: Puzzles from the Lichess.org open database (CC0).
footer.made: Made to bring people closer to chess.
